description: Red de estaciones de referencia GNSS de la Comunitat Valenciana (ERVA) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. Active geodetic network of the Valencian Community is made up of 10 GNSS stations, in permanent operation as a positioning service, which distributes real-time corrections and hourly and daily RINEX observation files. Coverage: Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. The portal shows the English title as "Network of GNSS reference stations of the Valencian Community (ERVA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. Its keywords include IDEV, GNSS, España, Espanya, EUREF, redGAE. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2023-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
